summary: MARA Holdings, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting that its subsidiary MARA USA Corporation entered into an Equity Purchase Agreement to acquire 100% of Long Ridge Energy Power LLC from Ohio River Partners Holdco LLC and Ohio River Partners Finance LLC for a base purchase price of approximately $1.5 billion, subject to customary adjustments. The target owns a 485 MW combined-cycle gas turbine plant in Ohio, increasing to 505 MW in H2 2026, and over 1,600 acres of industrially permitted land. The board recommendation is not stated; no advisors named. The acquisition will be financed through debt and other proceeds, with post-closing obligations and cooperation for change-of-control consents. Watch for regulatory approvals and debt financing execution, with risk-arb focused on closing timeline and consent solicitation outcomes on the target's 8.750% Senior Secured Notes due 2032.
